555K likes, 2,365 comments - cbum on October 28, 2026: "It’s hard to imagine going through life without training. Im so grateful I developed this habit and love for it at such a young age.

It’s been a constant in my life. An anchor that helps me clear my head, find clarity, and stay centered through all the different seasons of life.

What started as a love for training has become something that adds so much more to my life. And I appreciate that maybe even more now in retirement.".

posts.meta_description:
914K likes, 1,528 comments - cbum on September 29, 2026: "My biggest takeaway from this Olympia is realizing what I actually miss.

I miss the emotion that comes with dedicating yourself completely to a goal. Giving everything you have to something, experiencing the highest highs and the lowest lows, and sharing those moments with the people closest to you who saw everything it took to get there.

Watching the athletes on stage and seeing everything they were feeling brought back a lot of memories. There’s something incredibly special about caring that deeply about something and finding out how far you’re willing to go for it.

But at the same time, I felt more clear than ever.

Because I know exactly what it takes to stand on that stage, I also know the sacrifice it requires. And for me, that sacrifice just isn’t worth it anymore.

I can miss parts of that life without wanting it back.

The life I have now, and the life I’m building, mean far more to me than another trophy or another moment in the spotlight.".

3M likes, 23K comments - cbum on September 22, 2026: "Jacked and athletic. Slowly bridging the gap.

Apparently a 60 inch box jump was too easy of a goal. Now I need to be able to do it without the run-up.

Honestly it’s just fun to be able to express some of my training in different ways to see how I’m improving. Still a long way to go, but I’m proud of the progress.🤝".

202K likes, 735 comments - cbum on September 18, 2026: "My documentary finally gets to see the light of day 👀

A lot of time, work, and care has gone into making this film exactly what we wanted it to be.

The World Premiere will take place during opening weekend at the Austin Film Festival in Austin, Texas.

This will be the first time the film is shown publicly, which feels pretty crazy (and scary) to say.

For everyone asking when you’ll be able to watch it, we’ll be announcing the official release date very soon.

Almost there.".
